items.text: Hello again, Rabbits!
We've pushed a small hotfix live today with the following changes:
Fixed an issue so that Lana no longer gets blocked when Mr. Baesie is in the lift.
Fixed an issue where the sound effects for the bells on the wall in Ms. Fisherin's kitchen were missing.
Happy Friday, Rabbits!
We’ve just pushed another patch to address the issues listed below. We appreciate your continued support as we work to keep improving the game! Have a great weekend!
Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where the game no longer crashes during the Tar Scourge battle.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 7 where the character gets stuck after respawning near the cliff as Bunny Lana.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 10 where Mr. Kyn’s ground attack fails to hit when Lana uses the umbrella during the boss battle.
Fixed an issue where the Chapter title was untranslated or a placeholder when the user opens the objectives menu.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 1 and Chapter 3 in which multiple tutorial prompt displays were incorrect at the start of the chapter.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 10 where two dresses appear to have the number 93 in the dress shop section.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 3 where the bunny tutorial now mentions the healing mechanic.
Hello again, Rabbits!
We’ve released another patch to address the latest round of issues listed below. We appreciate your continual input and feedback!
Fixed an issue in Chapter 6 where Bunny Lana would get stuck inside of the box while switching characters on top of the box.
Fixed the redundant close button that appeared on options UI after navigating back from the brightness selection screen.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 6 where the camera failed to adjust correctly when Mr. Baesie's head jumped onto the button.
Fixed the incorrect pop-up that appeared when the player spammed the transformation input.
Fixed a gameplay issue where Mr. Kyn stuttered and failed to attack when he approached the rabbit near its hiding spot.
Fixed an issue where Bunny Lana was able to escape from the red-eyed enemy on the basement floor.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where the character would run in place after collecting the electric cable.
In the objective tab the Chapter displays as “Capitolo” after changing the language.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 3 where Lana automatically pulled down the lever while attempting to jump on the box.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 2 where the invisible collision occurs without any user input.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 2 where the character disappeared after intentionally getting attacked and dies because of Velenia.
Fixed the general settings so that "Subtitle Back Box" is present instead of "Subtitle Black Box"
Fixed the issue where Mr. Baesie's head could jump over objects if you are holding the direction toward the object.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 6 where the dance tokens were shown as the incorrect input before the player input is applied.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where the Tar Scourge boss no longer gains invulnerability after the boss is hit.
Fixed an issue where Mr. Baesie's compressed head no longer fails to transform into the full version of his head after respawning in Chapter 3.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where the game no longer crashes during the Tar Scourge battle.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 7 where the character no longer gets stuck after respawning near the cliff as Bunny Lana.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 10 where Mr. Kyn’s ground attack would fail to hit when Lana uses the umbrella during the boss battle.
Happy Monday, Rabbits!
We’ve just pushed a small patch to address the issues listed below. Thanks for your continued support as we keep improving the game!
Fixed a blocker in Chapter 10 where the player gets blocked in the business room.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 so that Lana no longer gets stuck at the beginning of the Tar Scourge boss fight.
Fixed an issue where the player could constantly transform and become stuck in the game with clipping issues.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 10 so that Lana is now able to jump over the movable box without needing to switch into bunny mode.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 6 where Bunny Lana gets stuck inside the box while switching characters on top of the box.

Hello, Dear Rabbits! 🐇 We wanted to take the time to thank you all again for your invaluable feedback and support! Today, we’re pleased to announce our third patch is now live, including: the ability to restart a chapter during a level!
Please see below for patch note details.
New feature: Added an option to restart a chapter from the beginning.
Access the chapter restart from the pause menu
Fixed an issue causing rabbit Lana to respawn below ground level when being killed by Ms Fisherin, blocking progress.
Fixed a prompt for jumping from the ladder to the crane in Chapter 10 to be occasionally missing.
Fixed several collision issues in Chapter 6 causing Lana to get stuck in the geometry.
Fixed an issue causing Lana to respawn below ground level after dying from falling in the electrified pond while transforming in Chapter 5.
Fixed a collision issue causing Lana to disappear when jumping from the cupboard while evading Mr Kyn in Chapter 4.
Fixed an issue causing Lana to teleport towards Baesie in Chapter 5 causing the player to lose input control.
Fixed an issue preventing Baesie to walk up/down stairs when transforming on them.
Fixed issue permitting players to climb down the wall in chapter 1 instead of up, causing Lana's death.
Fixed an issue causing the staircase from Chapter 2 to sometimes reappear after collapsing.
Fixed an issue causing Lana to remain in a panic state in Chapter 6 after the enemy left the premises.
Fixed the brightness slider.
Fixed a repeated dialog regarding fertilizer in Chapter 7 causing confusion on the next steps.
Hi Rabbits,
The highly-requested feature Chapter Restart is coming to Bye Sweet Carole!

Hello Dear Rabbits! 🐇 We're pleased to share the second patch is now live. Thank you for your patience as the team continues to refine and improve the game based on your feedback! We plan to release an additional patch soon, and we will keep you updated on timing!
Fixed an issue causing Lana to get stuck hanging from the handle and preventing her from grabbing it in the waste room in Chapter 3
Fixed an issue causing Lana to rotate the crank indefinitely during the well boss fight in Chapter 5
Fixed an issue causing Mr. Baesie to fall through geometry when using the dumbwaiter in the control room in Chapter 6
Fixed an issue causing a black screen upon entering the dining room from the elevator shaft in Chapter 10
Fixed a prompt that was occasionally missing to open a door in Chapter 7, blocking the player in the Library
Hello, Dear Rabbits! 🐇

First off, we wanted to take a moment to thank every single one of you who joined us on this unique journey in the Kingdom of Corolla. Your support means the world to us! Thank you for all of the love and kind words you've shared. 🌹

Over the past week, we’ve been closely monitoring your feedback and identifying the top issues to address. Today, we're releasing Patch 1.0, which includes several important fixes based on your feedback. We appreciate your input as the team continues to work on creating the best experience possible for players! The team is already hard at work on the next patch, which will be coming later this month. Stay tuned! Here are the key fixes and improvements included in this patch:
Fixed an issue causing players to occasionally lose input and “hold your breath” UI in a hiding spot, specifically in the shower room in Chapter 4
Fixed a collision issue causing Lana to get stuck in the walls after climbing down in the lower part of the future Library in Chapter 7
Fixed an issue occasionally preventing Lana from interacting with the crank in the Sewing Room in Chapter 4
Fixed a rare infinite loading issue when trying to go back to the dancing room after leaving in Chapter 6
Fixed a rare issue blocking Lana in the searching animation after finding the crank during the boss fight in Chapter 5
Fixed an issue causing the mannequin to occasionally appear twice in the Sewing Room in Chapter 4
Made it impossible for the player to go through the gate in the Sewing Room before fully opening it, preventing a softlock in Chapter 4
Fixed a rare infinity loading issue when reaching the Tower in Chapter 10
Fixed an issue in the Sewing room where the mannequin wouldn't fall from the top level, blocking Lana on the crate and preventing progression

We’ll continue working on additional fixes, optimizations and improvements across all platforms to ensure the smoothest possible experience for everyone. Thank you once again for your patience and feedback!
Little Sewing Machine and Maximum Entertainment
Dear Rabbits,
We're thrilled to share some exciting news and updates about Bye Sweet Carole! 🌹
Road to Gamescom 2025

For the very first time, Bye Sweet Carole will be playable during Gamescom 2025 in Germany, and we sincerely can't wait to welcome you to experience what we've been crafting with passion over the past 3 years.
The playable demo will be available at the Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.2), so if you're attending, be sure to stop and say hi!
We’ve made refinements to the game’s visual direction to further embrace the classic animation film aesthetic that inspired us. As Bye Sweet Carole’s creator, Chris Darril, explains:
“We wanted to have this nice and authentic effect, close to what we can call ‘chromatic aberration’, that gives a vintage, warmer and more emotional aspect to the game and to Lana’s adventures.”

Physical Editions

Finally, we’re excited to share that Bye Sweet Carole will also be releasing physically on PS5 and Nintendo Switch! Here’s a little sneak peek, with more details to come soon, including some exclusive bonuses we can’t wait to reveal!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/d288a2dac8263398e1cd6a08d8256a663b246585.png"]
You can already pre-order the game at your local retailer or at https://byesweetcarole.com/
We hope you'll enjoy this haunting yet beautiful journey into the kingdom of Corrola.
Stay tuned for more exciting news coming very soon!
Little Sewing Machine & Maximum Entertainment
